title: Compile all G20 carry columns into 26-bit packed machines
body:
All 444 released G20 routes now have a packed finite-table carry producer. Across 3,552 columns / 729 distinct columns, the maximum retained between-row state falls from PR6474's 78-bit separate-counter bound to 26 bits. The source carry identity, canonical input validation and five-bit packet interface are preserved.

The construction uses 23 shared models. Complete reachable-state tables, refinement histories and bisimulation checks certify each quotient component's minimum over its declared unrestricted aggregate alphabet. This does not claim a minimum for the complete valid-input packet machine. The runtime directly reads packed tables: 464,866 bytes plus 2,679 metadata bytes. Table storage and physical access are not free.

The independent checker uses floor inequalities for every transition, validates every refinement partition and every packed entry, then checks 17,760 source-column cases, all 49,449 active q=3 inputs, seven 4,097-bit streams and seven rejecting controls against an independent modular oracle. The unchanged physical packet consumer is not re-audited; equality of its input packet is the retained interface.

CPython 3.12.14 normal/optimized registered checks, committed byte/mode checks, official export and read-only Git-free/empty-PATH normal/optimized replay pass at `03e47a1a258f87d4a5bce86292f1a1b815ed0f52`. Hosted CI is pending. The optional full-history preflight was not run in this shallow checkout; the live route source is in the immediate main parent and included in the cold export.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-compact-carry-machines`.

No runtime saving, complete physical caller, native admission, new kappa or selected-frontier change. Next: price actual table lookup, interleaved low-cache delivery, scratch cleanup and head return against the counter implementation.

[Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4945#discussioncomment-19363662). Canonical main, revision 8 and live scopes were refreshed before submission. Credit PR6474's carry producer, PR5820, ToikY, Nick Petalas, Tekalign, JoyboyBrian, Kyu's distinct packed-carry precedent, the full G20/native/ROW lineage and classical finite-automaton refinement. Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.
